query: SELECT DISTINCT le.customerId, c.fullName, (SELECT balanceAfterUsd FROM ledgerEntries le2 WHERE le2.customerId = le.customerId ORDER BY le2.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) as currentBalance FROM ledgerEntries le JOIN customers c ON le.customerId = c.id HAVING currentBalance > 0 LIMIT 20;
